description: Update a worker profile (name, phone, email, actor_kind), or deactivate / reactivate the worker (active false / true with an optional reason: receipted as a ledger event first, never a delete; a merged record is never reactivated). Changing actor_kind to or from agent or admin is refused for every key: only an org owner or admin, signed in to the portal, can do that.

active.description: SR-API3: false deactivates the worker, true reactivates it (receipted)

actor_kind.description: What this worker row stands for (to or from agent / admin: owner or admin session only)

reason.description: Why (recorded with an active change; at most 500 characters)

name: tascan_update_worker
